sources.entry: HumHub - Flexible kit for private social networks. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: HumHub is an open-source, modular PHP platform used as a social network, knowledge database, intranet, or internal communication and collaboration platform.
summary.what_it_does: Provides user profiles that users can customize and follow each other through, plus Spaces (rooms or groups for projects, departments, or events) into which users can be mapped. Users can create content such as posts, wiki pages, photos/videos, appointments, events, and tasks, shared with members of a Space, with multi-level comments and reporting of inappropriate content. Content, Spaces, and members can be found through filter and search functions, and content can be edited, deleted, or archived. Functionality is extended through roughly 80 installable and activatable modules, named in the README as including Advanced LDAP, RESTful API, Mass User Import, Calendar, Wiki, OnlyOffice, JWT SSO, Tasks, Gallery, News, Polls, and Mail for Direct Messages. The interface is responsive and works on smartphones and tablets, and the README states it is available in over 30 languages.
use_cases: Private social network for an organization
Sharing files and content among members
notable: Organizes users into Spaces with an advanced permission and notification system, including email summaries
Modular architecture with roughly 80 extension modules, including LDAP, REST API, and SSO options
Includes OnlyOffice and wiki/calendar/tasks modules among its extensions
Responsive design with support for over 30 languages
caveats: The README does not describe installation steps in the provided text, so setup requirements are unclear from this summary
Many key features are delivered as modules, so the available functionality depends on which ones are installed and activated
